openings.claim: Quantity-memory errors may explain shared-material omissions. Pencil pattern and quantities on envelopes; tick only after insertion. Exterior patterns may reduce assignment exchanges.
openings.discriminator: Matched loose staging succeeding while marked shared-tray kits fail challenges memory dominance; correctly ticked incomplete kits defeat insertion checking.
openings.probe: Within 18 minutes including preparation/audit, alternate three matched four-kit batches: incumbent shared trays, marked/ticked shared trays, loose local staging without cues. Audit against samples; tally crossings, omissions and all time. Stop if staging exceeds table space.
openings.uncertainty: Legibility, table footprint and cap feasibility unverified; O4 mixture unknown. Rare sample use does not locate omissions.

openings.claim: Two competing hypotheses: cross-reaching interrupts picking; pattern switching confuses shared-material quantities. Tags identify materials but neither prevents interruptions nor specifies current-pattern quantities.
openings.discriminator: Placement-driven improvement under both orders favors interruptions; blocking-driven improvement across placements favors switching. Persistent omissions without crossings challenge interruptions; successful interleaved local staging with unsuccessful shared blocking challenges switching.
openings.probe: One 24-kit factorial: shared/local placement by blocked/interleaved order, six kits per cell, two per pattern. Equal tag/sample access; counterbalance volunteer/cell order. Tally crossings, pre-correction omissions and elapsed time; correct immediately. Cap at 35 minutes within 90.
openings.uncertainty: Local fit and O4 switching frequency unknown; clean small-batch results establish neither mechanism nor full-run success.

lineage.reason: Preserves envelope mechanism, distribution benefit and falsifiers.
Placement hypothesis retained explicitly in shared factorial.
Switching rival and distinct predictions retained explicitly.

decision: All evidence is synthetic. Select a bounded probe, not both cumulatively. Preserve specified quantities/dimensions; exactly two volunteers; total work at most 90 minutes; existing 180-by-75-centimetre table, envelopes and supplies; no purchases/equipment. Target 60 assigned kits with at most one distribution correction. Picking versus filling and opened-packet area remain unknown; supply availability also needs attention.
